title: Introduction To Sociolinguistics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the actual use and realisation of language, which is alike to parole, that relates to the appliance of language, the actual process of speaking."
Performance refers to the actual use and realisation of language, which is alike to parole, that relates to the appliance of language, the actual process of speaking.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to any admixture of linguistic elements of two or more language systems in the same utterance at various levels: phonological, lexical, grammatical and orthographical."
Code-mixing refers to any admixture of linguistic elements of two or more language systems in the same utterance at various levels: phonological, lexical, grammatical and orthographical.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to short-lived coinages that do not belong to a language's standard vocabulary."
Slang refers to short-lived coinages that do not belong to a language's standard vocabulary.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the speech variety of an individual speaker."
An idiolect is the speech variety of an individual speaker.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to live in colonies or clusters in many parts of Lagos and they speak purely Hausa or Fulani as the case may be instead of English or Pidgin."
The Hausa communities in Lagos are known to live in colonies or clusters in many parts of Lagos and they speak purely Hausa or Fulani as the case may be instead of English or Pidgin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex process of sociolinguistic change, comprising reduction in inner form, with convergence, in the context of restriction in use."
Pidginisation is a complex process of sociolinguistic change, comprising reduction in inner form, with convergence, in the context of restriction in use.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most complex products of the human mind, each differing enormously in its sounds, structure, and pattern of thought."
General Overview Languages are the most complex products of the human mind, each differing enormously in its sounds, structure, and pattern of thought.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the locus of most sociolinguistic and anthropological-linguistic research, indeed all linguistic research that is accountable to a body of naturally-occurring speech or signed data."

The speech act and speech event are the locus of most sociolinguistic and anthropological-linguistic research, indeed all linguistic research that is accountable to a body of naturally-occurring speech or signed data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the linguistic variety used by government, the mass media, business, education, science, and the arts in Nigeria."
Standard English is the linguistic variety used by government, the mass media, business, education, science, and the arts in Nigeria.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concept in sociolinguistics that describes a more or less discrete group of people who use language in a unique and mutually accepted way among themselves."
Speech community is a concept in sociolinguistics that describes a more or less discrete group of people who use language in a unique and mutually accepted way among themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a wider concept than style of prose or style of language."
Variety is a wider concept than style of prose or style of language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to not having the ability to speak several languages."
Note that monoglottism can only refer to not having the ability to speak several languages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the linguistic idiosyncrasy of that individual; how s/he speaks, writes or communicates as distinguishable from others."
An individual style refers to the linguistic idiosyncrasy of that individual; how s/he speaks, writes or communicates as distinguishable from others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most extended and vastly developed subgroup of non- standard colloquial layer of the vocabulary of a given type of language."
Common Colloquial Words Slang is the most extended and vastly developed subgroup of non- standard colloquial layer of the vocabulary of a given type of language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variety of many languages because of such varieties as Pidgin English, pidgin French, pidgin Spanish etc."
Pidgin language is a variety of many languages because of such varieties as Pidgin English, pidgin French, pidgin Spanish etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a result of such a process that has achieved autonomy as a norm."
A pidgin is a result of such a process that has achieved autonomy as a norm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a factor of social situations."
Linguistic mode is a factor of social situations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special language code used by different people, professionals to identify and relate with each other, using patterned and acceptable codes unanimously accepted by them."
A register is a special language code used by different people, professionals to identify and relate with each other, using patterned and acceptable codes unanimously accepted by them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known for their usual peaceful dispositions, simple lifestyle and attachment to their belief."
The Christians are known for their usual peaceful dispositions, simple lifestyle and attachment to their belief.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term given to the use of different varieties of language in different social situations."
Code- switching is the term given to the use of different varieties of language in different social situations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system in that it has a large number of elements whereby meaning is assumed in the arrangements of its elements and the consequent relationships between these arranged elements."
Langue is a system in that it has a large number of elements whereby meaning is assumed in the arrangements of its elements and the consequent relationships between these arranged elements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known for his aggressive attachment to his religion."
A Nigerian Muslim is known for his aggressive attachment to his religion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term in ordinary people's language."
Vulgarisms Vulgarism is a term in ordinary people's language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of social artefact."
General Overview Language is a form of social artefact.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a certain form of a language spoken by a subgroup of speakers of that language which is defined mainly by phonological features."
An accent is a certain form of a language spoken by a subgroup of speakers of that language which is defined mainly by phonological features.
fib: ______ is the official language and Igbo, Hausa and Yoruba are regarded as the acceptable languages for official situations.
English
English is the official language and Igbo, Hausa and Yoruba are regarded as the acceptable languages for official situations.
______ is the study of the effect of any and all aspects of society, including cultural norms, expectations, and context on the way language is used. 9.
Sociolinguistics
Sociolinguistics is the study of the effect of any and all aspects of society, including cultural norms, expectations, and context on the way language is used. 9.
______ is an aspect of the broader relationship between power and language.
issue of respect
The issue of respect is an aspect of the broader relationship between power and language.
______ are those areas where a regional language is used in informal, usually oral, contexts, while the state language is used in more formal situations.
Typical diglossic areas
Typical diglossic areas are those areas where a regional language is used in informal, usually oral, contexts, while the state language is used in more formal situations.
______ is a tool for us to construct ourselves as social beings, to signal who we are and who we are not and cannot be.
Linguistic variation
Linguistic variation is a tool for us to construct ourselves as social beings, to signal who we are and who we are not and cannot be.
______ is a rule for checkmating errors in a language by the second language users.
standard language
A standard language is a rule for checkmating errors in a language by the second language users.

Fottar (to fuck)
Fottar
Fottar (to fuck) is used much as in English, e.g., "Fotta te!" ("Fuck you!") or "Mi auto es fottate!" ("My car is fucked!").
______ is the concrete use of the language, the actual utterances.
Parole
Parole is the concrete use of the language, the actual utterances.
______ is used, there are determinants which are societal based.
Before language
Before language is used, there are determinants which are societal based.
______ are used in India, Cameroon, and Nigeria, for example.
English-based pidgins
English-based pidgins are used in India, Cameroon, and Nigeria, for example.
______ refers to the language that is more dominant or more prevalent language in daily discourse.
matrix language
The matrix language refers to the language that is more dominant or more prevalent language in daily discourse.
______ are known for their good use of the fricatives, plosives and dental fricatives.
Ghanaian users
The Ghanaian users are known for their good use of the fricatives, plosives and dental fricatives.
______ is a means to instantiate, to realise and to give shape to (aspects of) the social.
Language
Language is a means to instantiate, to realise and to give shape to (aspects of) the social.
______ is a stable variation which varies within a population based on age.
Age-graded variation
Age-graded variation is a stable variation which varies within a population based on age.
______ is the term given to the special technical terminology of any given language (usually English) in a legal document.
Legalese
Legalese is the term given to the special technical terminology of any given language (usually English) in a legal document.
______ is the most populated black nation in the world, with over 400 languages and thousands of dialects.
Nigeria
Nigeria is the most populated black nation in the world, with over 400 languages and thousands of dialects.
______ refers to a nonstandard vocabulary used by secret groups, particularly criminal organisations, usually intended to render communications incomprehensible to outsiders.
Argot
Argot refers to a nonstandard vocabulary used by secret groups, particularly criminal organisations, usually intended to render communications incomprehensible to outsiders.
______ is the degree to which one interlocutor is able to control the behaviour of the other.
Power
Power is the degree to which one interlocutor is able to control the behaviour of the other.
______ is a part of Great Britain, although Welsh is a Celtic language and is not related to English.
Wales
Wales is a part of Great Britain, although Welsh is a Celtic language and is not related to English.
______ is the whole system of language that precedes and makes speech possible.
La langue
La langue is the whole system of language that precedes and makes speech possible.
______ is the change of one language to another within the same utterance or in the same oral/ written text.
General Overview Code-mixing
General Overview Code-mixing is the change of one language to another within the same utterance or in the same oral/ written text.
______ are the varieties of language use.
Lects
Lects are the varieties of language use.
______ is a special type of vocabulary in a given language.
jargon
Professional and Social Jargons A jargon is a special type of vocabulary in a given language.
______ is the syntactically and phonologically appropriate use of multiple varieties.
Code-switching
Code-switching is the syntactically and phonologically appropriate use of multiple varieties.
______ means that one also has to understand the social networks in which language is embedded.
Understanding language in society
